description: Two-sided New York founder card. Front: ALL-CAPS wordmark BRIGHTFOLD, a lower-case tagline that happens to contain the industry word 'infrastructure', and the bare domain brightfold.io. Back: a small 'Hello, I'm' greeting line above the big name line 'Jordan Blake (he/him)' with inline pronouns, 'Founder & CEO', a single lowercase 'cell (212) 555-0199 · office (212) 555-0142' line (both numbers in US parenthesised format, middle-dot separator), work email, bare 'linkedin.com/in/…' path, and a single-line street address ending in a ZIP+4 ('New York, NY 10005-1402'). No legal suffix anywhere.
